unregistered-client.title: Runbook: register the client for real first (POST /register), then use the client_id it returns, never a hand-typed or remembered one
Runbook: if you are NOT mounting mcpAuthRouter, this validation does not exist yet; add it yourself before this server is safe to expose

redirect-uri-mismatch.title: Runbook: the redirect_uri on this request must be byte-identical to one returned by this client's own /register call (loopback port is the one relaxation, RFC 8252 SS7.3); register the real one rather than editing the request to match

pkce-mismatch.title: Runbook: send the code_verifier from the SAME PKCE pair whose challenge was sent to /authorize for this code, not a freshly generated one

unsupported-grant-type.title: Runbook: use grant_type=authorization_code (the initial exchange) or grant_type=refresh_token (renewal); this server has no other grant to reach for

csp-blocks-consent-form.title: Runbook: widen form-action to name every real origin the consent form actually posts to (form-action 'self' https://your-mcp-origin), never form-action 'self' alone when the OAuth endpoints live on a different origin or port; the exact value is deployment-specific, so name your own real origin, do not copy one from elsewhere
Runbook: same-origin the consent UI and the OAuth endpoints (serve both from the one origin behind the same reverse proxy) and form-action 'self' alone is correct and needs no widening
